SpeechToText.//: Provider: Browser = SPA transcribes locally (no audio leaves the browser); Cloud = SPA uploads audio, server calls Endpoint with ApiKey; Disabled = voice capture off; Demo = fixed sample sentence (dev only).

Email.//: SMTP for password-reset emails. Real values via env vars (Email__SmtpHost, Email__FromEmail, Email__Username, Email__Password) or user-secrets — see Documents/.env.example. Disabled by default.

Gemini.//: ApiKey must NEVER be set here. Use `dotnet user-secrets set "Gemini:ApiKey" "..."` in Development, or the Gemini__ApiKey env var elsewhere.

Captcha.//: Provider: turnstile | recaptcha | hcaptcha | disabled. SecretKey via env (Captcha__SecretKey) / user-secrets only. 'disabled' + DevBypassToken works ONLY in Development.
